items.title: Scientists turn sheep’s wool into a material that helps regrow bone
items.summary: Keratin extracted from sheep’s wool helped damaged bone regenerate in animals, producing tissue that was more organized and structurally similar to healthy bone than tissue grown with conventional collagen scaffolds. items.title: The perfect storm that turbocharged Venezuela's twin quakes
items.summary: A dangerous cocktail of tectonic positioning, loose earth and shoddy construction contributed to the unprecedented damage caused by Venezuela's twin earthquakes, experts say.

items.title: James Webb captures a cosmic lion sculpted by a dying star
